postUrls.title: Instagram post URLs
postUrls.description: One or more Instagram post or reel URLs to collect comments from. Comments are pooled across all posts before the draw.

numberOfWinners.title: Number of winners
numberOfWinners.description: How many winning comments to randomly pick from the eligible pool.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of comments to scrape per post URL. Tip: keep this close to how many comments the post actually has — setting it much higher does not find more comments and can make the scraper retry until it gets rate-limited.

uniqueUsers.title: Unique users only
uniqueUsers.description: If enabled, each Instagram user can win at most once even if they commented multiple times. The first comment per user is kept.

requireMention.title: Must mention/tag someone
requireMention.description: If enabled, only comments that tag at least one other account (e.g. @friend) are eligible. Common giveaway rule.

requiredKeyword.title: Required keyword / hashtag
requiredKeyword.description: If set, only comments containing this keyword or hashtag (case-insensitive) are eligible.
